audience: sales teams that track contacts, deals and follow-ups in OnePageCRM

useCases.title: Review open deals by pipeline
useCases.text: List the deal pipelines with their stages. List the deals, then read one deal for its value and stage.

useCases.title: Look up a company and its notes
useCases.text: List the companies, then read one company with its linked contacts. List the notes logged against that company.

useCases.title: Find follow-up tasks
useCases.text: List the next actions, filtered by status, contact, company or assignee. Read a contact for context.

useCases.title: Log a call and move a lead forward
useCases.text: Add a note to a contact, optionally linked to a deal. Then change the status of the contact, for example from lead to customer.

useCases.title: Add a contact and close a task
useCases.text: Create a contact with a last name or a company name. Mark an action done when the task is finished.
